response.message: Astra: We’ll leave the unresolved execution-evidence question aside for now; another correction on it is unlikely to help. Within your regression comparison, look instead at what you want the training-time measurement to mean. Your drafts move between grid search and retraining. Which operation matters for your comparison, and where would you focus a brief inspection to determine whether the draft measures that operation? Work with one existing draft rather than generating the whole script again.
